parameters.text:
🔍 Got it! Researching *{{ $json.topic }}*...

My agents are working on it:
✅ Agent 1: Web Research
⏳ Agent 2: Statistics Finder
⏳ Agent 3: Expert Insights
⏳ Agent 4: Report Compiler

_Please wait 1-2 minutes..._

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "llama-3.3-70b-versatile",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "You are Agent 4 - a Professional Report Compiler. You receive research from 3 specialist agents and compile it into a clean, structured 2-page research report. Format the report in clean Markdown with the following sections:

# Research Report: [Topic]

## 1. Executive Summary
(2-3 sentences overview)

## 2. Overview & Background
(from web research agent)

## 3. Key Statistics & Data
(from statistics agent - use bullet points)

## 4. Expert Insights & Future Outlook
(from expert insights agent)

## 5. Key Takeaways
(3-5 bullet points summarizing the most important findings)

---
Report generated by Multi-Agent Research System (Powered by Groq + LLaMA 3.3)

Make it professional, well-structured, and easy to read."
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Compile a full research report on the topic: {{ $json.topic }}

--- AGENT 1 OUTPUT (Web Research) ---
{{ $json.webResearch }}

--- AGENT 2 OUTPUT (Statistics) ---
{{ $json.statistics }}

--- AGENT 3 OUTPUT (Expert Insights) ---
{{ $json.expertInsights }}"
    }
  ],
  "temperature": 0.5,
  "max_tokens": 2048
}
